title: BNY资管：债市或迎喘息式修复
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Joining us now from Hong Kong is April LaRouce co-head of Global Client Portfolio Management at B&Y Investments. April, thanks so much for your time today. I just want to start with
segments.zh: 现在从香港连线的是B&Y**全球客户组合管理联席主管April LaRouce。April，感谢你今天抽时间。我想先从

segments.en: what we're seeing in the bond space at the yield on the 10-year coming just down a little today.
segments.zh: 债券市场的表现开始，10年期收益率今天只是小幅下行。

segments.en: Have we seen the peak yet? Can we say that with any confidence? I'm not sure we can say that with a complete confidence, but it does look like for the past
segments.zh: 我们是否已经见顶？能有多大把握这么说？我不能说完全有把握，但看起来过去

segments.en: about five trading sessions, US Treasuries are trying to find a base here. I mean, frankly, there is a lot of bad news in the price when it comes to potential future interest rate hikes.
segments.zh: 大约五个交易日，美国国债在试图寻找底部。坦率地说，就未来潜在加息而言，价格中已经包含了很多坏消息。

segments.en: A lot of this obviously being driven, as you say, by interest rate hikes, which is in turn, is being driven by inflation, which in turn is being driven by this endless conflict in the
segments.zh: 正如你所说，这很大程度上由加息驱动，而加息又由通胀驱动，通胀则源于中东无休止的冲突。

segments.en: Middle East at the moment. So, essential banks alone are going to be able to do enough to tame inflation and help get that yield curve down. Yeah, that is the big question. And frankly,
segments.zh: 所以，仅靠央行能否足够遏制通胀并帮助收益率曲线下行？是的，这是个大问题。坦率地说，

segments.en: all the fixed income markets are looking very closely at what's happening with oil from minute to minute because, of course, that is primarily what's causing concerns. And the inflation numbers alone
segments.zh: 所有固定收益市场都在密切关注油价的每分钟变化，因为这正是引发担忧的主要原因。而通胀数据本身

segments.en: are not a surprise. I mean, frankly, US inflation has spent something like 60 months above target.
segments.zh: 并不令人意外。坦率地说，美国通胀已有约60个月高于目标水平。

segments.en: The concern is that if inflation expectations become unhinged and obviously that's what central banks are trying to deal with. Obviously, the sooner we see some sort of resolution
segments.zh: 担忧在于通胀预期是否会失控，这显然是央行正在应对的。显然，越早看到中东局势

segments.en: with the situation in the Middle East, the better as far as bond markets are concerned.
segments.zh: 得到某种解决，对债券市场就越有利。
